messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a quick UX decision for the auto-fallback policy in the console. Core question: how do we surface degrade modes + triggers + quota impacts to operators in a single view? cc @liam @sarah
liam: short take — show 1) trigger reason (error/latency/quota), 2) degrade mode (soft / silent / hard), 3) quota/reservation impact, all inline on the rollout card so ops don't have to open multiple pages.
sarah: Agree. Also add a lightweight 'why' link to open the audit playback + a compact sampling toggle. Operators should be able to preview sampled requests before flipping anything.
dan: For the API: apps need programmatic telemetry. Include structured reason codes in the route status endpoint and expose a header like: `X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=soft;reason=latency;id=0x9f3a`
aj: We already have a simple fallback header for model switching. Adding structured reason is fine but limit to enums for reason/mode to keep clients simple.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of `autofallback-ux` branch started by @liam — logs: https://ci.redwood/example-run/4721 (will post status)
maya: UX asks we need to ship: 1) inline chip for mode + hover tooltip, 2) small 'Audit' button that opens playback with sampled requests, 3) quota delta preview (est. monthly token impact). Thoughts?
liam: :thumbsup: chip + tooltip works. For quota delta, show a projected percent delta and link to the Optimize page for batching/quantization suggestions. Keep the numbers conservative (use 95th percentile).
sarah: Also propose a 'sample-only' (silent) mode: records decisions and telemetry but doesn't alter routing — good for measuring impact for 24–72h.
dan: API side should support `?dry_run=true` on the rollout endpoints and return the same decision headers so clients can test behavior.
aj: Ensure telemetry includes a `decision_id` for each fallback event to join traces later. Stick to current v1 event schema but add `fallback_reason` enum.
maya: Edge-case: oscillation when autoswitch flips modes rapidly. UX idea: show last N decisions + cooldown timer and a prominent 'Pause auto-changes' CTA.
liam: Agree. Add a compact 'cooldown' pill and a link to pause automatic changes. Place on rollout detail page near the chip.
sarah: Action items: (1) liam — header + UI chip PR, (2) dan — `dry_run` support + emit `decision_id`, (3) aj — update API schema and telemetry docs, (4) maya — UX mock by EOD Thu.
dan: I'll open the PR. Quick question: what's max size we want for `X-Redwood-Fallback`? Keep it tiny — suggest 128 chars.
aj: 128 bytes is fine. Semicolon-separated `k=v` pairs. We'll add exact grammar to the API docs and include an example.
maya: Example compact chip we will render in the UI: `[Soft] ⓘ — Trigger: latency (p99 > 800ms). Quota delta: -4.2% (est). Audit: preview`
sarah: Love the copy — keep it plain English for SREs. Also add a 'Why did we fallback?' modal that surfaces the top 3 signals and the sample requests.
liam: I'll map telemetry fields to UI. Also policy question: who can flip policy? Propose policy edits require rollout-owner + ops signoff (show permissions UI).
maya: Agreed — show required approvers on the rollout page and block the button if missing.
ops-bot: incident-bot: FYI, fallback sampling spike detected in prod us-west-2 at 2025-02-08T12:14Z — route: payment-checkout, sample-only mode currently enabled.
dan: Noted. I'll correlate `decision_id=0x9f3a` from the incident with logs and the sampled payloads.
aj: I'll update the API schema PR with `decision_id` field docs and an example `event` payload snippet:
```
{
  "decision_id": "0x9f3a",
  "route": "payment-checkout",
  "fallback": {"mode": "soft", "reason": "latency"},
  "sampled": true
}
```
maya: :white_check_mark: Good progress. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am to finalize copy, confirm API shape, and merge plan. If anyone wants to demo the canary, ping me in #devex.
